accepted_change: Only package_model opts into pack(..., guard_compressed_writes=True). Preserve existing tar.gz format, selected members/order/file bytes/modes/mtime and compresslevel1. Instead of requiring a second whole UNCOMPRESSED-size allocation before a compressed archive, create one exclusive owned output and check actual free space against each compressed write plus existing2GiB reserve. Default capture/common packing remains unchanged.
original_criterion_and_baselines: Original108 fresh cases/all10ops, prospectively frozen operation-model/Sheaft forecasts with absent or incomplete SDK, external outcomes, and equal-information Native/no-agent/direct conditional/cheap observed-context union baselines remain unchanged. This is storage/resource engineering, not a new predictor, utility, cost superiority or weaker success criterion.
actual_motivation: The DF snapshot had37,429,166,080B free before proposed16GiB additional swap, leaving20,249,296,896B at that footprint. Four retained eBPF wire copies in portable discovery outputs alone can total19,254,478,028B; existing pack adds1percent/per-member overhead and2GiB reserve before creating a gzip-compressed model. Direct full-processing upload removes its second archive but does not remove this separate portable-model prepack bound. End-of-model free space remains unobserved; no future failure or fit is asserted.
mandatory_source_conditions: The option is narrow and explicit for portable model packing. No changes to captures/common guards, input selection, model algorithms, semantic supply, forecasts, targets or existing source/inventory checks.

Use a new owned exclusive output, no overwriting earlier archive or following a symlink. Unbuffered guarded file writes must complete all requested bytes or raise; write errors and short writes must not silently truncate output.

Apply budgeting to compressed header, data and trailer/finalization writes. Retain2GiB reserve for metadata and remaining work, record compressed bytes/actual minimum and final free disk, and check actual free space after package/manifest completion. Filesystem bookkeeping/concurrent host writes mean this is a practical fail-closed budget, not an absolute future free-space guarantee.

Create a complete package inventory/SHA only after successful archive close. A partial archive from any failure is never admitted as a valid complete portable model; if retained diagnostically, identify it as partial. Existing all-four successful model/freeze/package guards still precede targets.

Keep selected source bytes and metadata unchanged; generated archive SHA and volatile gzip/container timestamps are actual new identities, not a promise of byte-identical historical archives. Separate exact-source ROOT/IND review, focused archive/short-write/low-disk checks and normal CI remain required before execution.
strongest_simple_baseline_and_costs: Use one guarded standard gzip/tar write rather than data reduction, a new storage format, deduplication, custom remote upload or a second compression-counting pass. Count added filesystem checks, compression/IO/CPU/wall, metadata, all failed/repeated packaging, preparation, swap/paging, transfer/upload, CI/readout/review and unknown human costs. Technical disk failure stays retained; no positive-result retry or cost-dominance claim.
scope: Design review only. No source edits, tests/model/VM/probe execution, raw scientific body processing, merge, dispatch, restart or cancellation by reviewer.
